intro: When your space needs more than a bed, Glory steps up. With soft LED lighting, display shelves, and smart storage, it helps you stay organised without losing the luxe.

features.title: Light that sets the mood, your way
features.text: The built-in LED light with a dimmer function helps you create just the right atmosphere — whether you're winding down, reading in bed or setting a cosy evening glow.

features.title: Keep your essentials within arm’s reach
features.text: The ledge-style display on the headboard is perfect for your night-time must-haves — from books and glasses to your phone and a favourite photo.

features.title: Lift-up storage that works with you
features.text: With a spacious underbed box that’s easy to access, keeping your space organised has never been simpler — no clutter, no chaos, just seamless storage. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Soft comfort, where it matters most
features.text: The cushioned headboard invites you to lean back and relax — perfect for late-night scrolling, long reads or morning cuppas in bed.

features.title: A grand headboard that supports and impresses
features.text: Designed to be both a backrest and a visual anchor, the tall headboard brings a sense of luxury to your room while offering full support whenever you need it.

name: Upmods Glory King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
